name: C2-3 Decision Tree: a 20-questions classifier
description: A depth-3 tree on Iris, printed as its own rules

data.noteContent:
A decision tree asks one question at a time -- is this feature above this threshold? -- and each answer chooses the next question. Depth 3 means at most three questions before a species is named, which is small enough to read the whole model.

After a run the accuracy Print reads 0.9667, 29 of the 30 held-out flowers, and the second Print is the model itself, in text.

Iris ships with the repo, so nothing downloads. Raise max_depth to 8: the tree grows extra branches and the test accuracy falls to 0.9333, 28 of 30. A bigger model is not a better one.

決策樹一次只問一個問題 -- 這個特徵有沒有超過這個門檻？ -- 每個答案決定下一題。深度 3 表示最多問三題就要說出品種，小到整個模型可以直接讀完。

跑完之後，準確率的 Print 是 0.9667，也就是 30 朵保留的花裡對了 29 朵；第二個 Print 印的則是模型本身的文字形式。

Iris 隨專案一起附，不用下載。把 max_depth 調到 8：樹會長出更多分支，測試準確率反而掉到 0.9333，30 朵只對 28 朵。模型更大不等於更好。

The tree prints its rules with column numbers, not names: feature_0 to feature_3 are the CSV's four columns in order -- sepal length, sepal width, petal length, petal width. So the top rule, feature_2 <= 2.45, is a petal-length cut that separates setosa from the other two species on its own.

樹印出規則時用的是欄位編號而不是名稱：feature_0 到 feature_3 就是 CSV 的四個欄位依序排列 -- sepal length、sepal width、petal length、petal width。所以最上面那條 feature_2 <= 2.45 是花瓣長度的切線，光靠它就能把 setosa 和另外兩種分開。
